N1033-retained-address-interference-and-: Separate irreversible old-address interference from reversible trapping and its time cost For a>0 and independent exponential correct/wrong races at each correctly reached stage j, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k gives F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1) a/(a+B_j). The accumulated hazard exposure is S_L=sum_j B_j/a=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. Power-law contact assumptions give the source O(L^2),O(L log L),O(L) exposure cases; these are not generic exact asymptotics for -log F_L outside small hazards. A separate active/trapped model has P_j=a/[a+d_A+j*b*(x+d_T)/(r_esc+x+d_T)]. With no irreversible terms and r_esc>0, every stage eventually succeeds but E[T_L]=L/a+b*L*(L-1)/(2*a*r_esc). Thus retained sites can cause time cost without necessarily causing wrong products. Supplied constant nonnegative rates, a>0, integer L>=1 and stage-specific exponential race/reset premises. B_j must count actual irreversible wrong joining for the first model. In the second model trapping returns the same competent active state, r_esc+x+d_T>0, and the lossless eventual-success/time result additionally requires r_esc>0. Actual polymer contacts, donor selection/escape and chemical processing are not acquired by the formulas. The absorption law explicitly reuses U1025-retained-product-diversion under a scoped rate/failure mapping. A positional-contact law is supplied, not measured for the proposed construct. For u_j=B_j/a, -log F_L=sum log(1+u_j), while S_L=sum u_j: linearization needs small hazards. For any b_1>0, F_L<=(a/(a+b_1))^(L-1), so even summable positional interference does not give nonvanishing long-chain fidelity at fixed rates. Reversible capture is not an irreversible error by definition; the effective hazard preserves absorption probability, not the full waiting-time law. Zero escape can make trapping permanent even with no chemical damage. Aging, correlated/nonexponential rates, changing competence and additional losses need a changed model. Old irreversible-mask survival remains valid at its own killing/initial-state interface. No integrated relay, empirical contact law, protecting-group performance or source numerical programme is accepted here.
